_comment: Every setting the corpus stages use, in one place (corpus-build-plan-2026-10-04, Phase 0 item 13). Change here, never in code. Analysis settings (seed length, floors, grids) live in config/analysis_settings.json, written before the analysis, not here.

selection.duplicate_rule: same magazine; same volume+number, or same whole number in the same year, or same full date, or same cover month for magazines that are not more than monthly; year-only records never merge; the item with more pages is kept, the others are alternates

download.user_agent: pulp_fiction_corpus/1.0 (text-reuse study, KNU Digital Humanities Engineering Center; contact hkim1596@knu.ac.kr)
download._comment: retry_backoff_s are the waits between tries, capped at retry_wait_cap_s; the archive's text files (djvu.txt, djvu.xml, scandata) get three tries and are then recorded as missing; the JP2 master gets retry_max+1 tries and its failure fails the issue.

reading._comment: One reading worker per URL in servers. Each URL is a Surya inference server (vLLM container) started by hand on its own GPU — docs/corpus-run.md, 'The reading servers': port 8020 on GPU 0 (Heejin, 4 October: 'Use only GPU 0. No GPU 2.'); 8022 on GPU 3 if Heejin frees it. PULP_SURYA_SERVERS in the environment overrides this list at run time (the pastes build it from the servers that answer). spawn_env is what a worker passes to Surya when servers is empty and Surya spawns its own server: VLLM_GPUS picks the card, VLLM_GPU_TYPE=h100 sizes the batches for an 80-97 GB card (surya's table has no entry for the RTX PRO 6000). A worker whose server stops answering waits for it and marks no issue failed. SURYA_INFERENCE_PARALLEL keeps two workers' requests under the server's 104 sequences: with the default (96 each, 192 in all) the clients hung after their first batch on 4 October; 32 each (p50g) cost about a quarter of the reading speed (5 October: 1.45 pages a second, GPU 0 at 71%, against 1.9 and 86-89% before); 48 each (96 in all, p50k) stays under the 104. The settings are read again for every issue, so a change here takes effect at the next issue without a restart.

assembly.cross_issue_pass: per magazine, after all its issues are assembled

quality_score.definition: share of a story's tokens that are dictionary words (config/words.txt)

llm_link._comment: s12_llm_link: the box-linking stage (Heejin, 4 October 2026; on 5 October: "Using api costs too much. … Let the local model do the job as much as possible and if unavoidable let it flag them for a person."). local = the vLLM lane on GPU 2 (PASTE 8c: the lab's own Qwen3-14B, port 8023): a first reading of every page, and a second, thinking reading of the boxes the first was less than accept_local sure of; a page is flagged for a person only when a decision that changes a piece (flag_joins) stays open. escalate = the Claude API, off (enabled false) since 5 October; the first trial's numbers are in docs/corpus-build-log.md.

local._comment: the lane on GPU 2 (PASTE 8c): vllm/vllm-openai:latest serving the lab's own copy of Qwen3-14B at /home/tailab/shared/models/qwen3-14b, port 8023, 80% of the card; PULP_LLM_BASE_URL, PULP_LLM_MODEL and PULP_LLM_THINKING in the environment override base_url, model and thinking for a trial of another lane, model or mode (the lab also has qwen3.5-9b). The answer is held to a JSON schema (p50k; without it 24% of the first trial's answers could not be read). max_tokens grows with the page's boxes (about 60 a box) up to max_tokens_cap. page_concurrency: the pages of an issue asked at once; concurrency: issues at once (2 keeps the lane busy while an issue's last pages or its API calls finish).

second_pass._comment: the second reading: the same model with thinking on, asked about the doubtful boxes only; Qwen's recommended sampling for its thinking mode (temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20; greedy decoding makes it repeat itself); max_tokens covers the reasoning and the answer (plus 60 a box)

local._comment_extra_lanes: more lanes serving the same model, asked in turn with the first (e.g. the lab's own Qwen3-14B lane on GPU 1, {"base_url": "http://127.0.0.1:8004/v1", "model": "auto"} — only with Heejin's leave: it is the lab's)

escalate._comment: budget_usd: the most one run (a trial, the pilot run, the corpus run) spends on the API; budget_total_usd: the most all runs together spend (data/corpus/llm_link_spend.json), raised by hand. A refusal that retrying cannot cure (no credit — the account ran dry at 00:36 on 5 October after $12.65 —, a refused key, an unknown model) stops the API for the run; the pages are flagged instead.

thresholds._comment: accept_local: a box the first reading is less sure of goes to the second reading (0.95: in the first trial the local model and Opus 5.5 gave the same answer on 95% of the boxes the local model was at least 0.95 sure of, 99% of the begins-or-continues decisions, against 44-71% below). accept_second: a doubtful box is settled when the second reading is this sure, or when the two readings agree. flag_joins: an unsettled box is flagged only when one of the readings gives it one of these (they change where a piece begins or ends, or put advertising in a story). accept_api: the API's own threshold, when it is on.
